AppUpdate.VersionNotes: - A `--config <path>` command-line switch, naming the configuration file to use instead of the one under `%AppData%`. Everything follows it — the configuration itself, its `.bak` backups and the `.temp` file — and the pre-1.3 legacy migration is skipped, so a board started this way cannot disturb your real one. A missing or unusable path stops the app with an error rather than quietly falling back to the default configuration, which would be the very thing the switch is for avoiding.
